summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Defender Risk Adaptive 500 ETF (SPDF) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund targets US large-cap equity exposure through an actively managed fund-of-funds with a risk overlay. It seeks capital appreciation in the long run. SPDF was launched on Apr 15, 2026 and is issued by Defender.
